name: StoneAgeVR
summary: StoneAgeVR is a fun playground game based around socializing and and hanging out with friends! Run around the maps and do all there is to-do from getting fancy cosmetics to getting your pants scared of in horror. Here at synaptic interactive we want our game to be as pollished as possible so you as the player can have the best cleanest experiance. We also take toxicity and moderation very seriusly and will ban anyone from the game breaking the code of conduct.
